welcome: Namaste! I can help you apply for an EWS certificate. I will check your documents before submission so your application is not rejected.
ask_identity: Please send a photo of your Aadhaar or identity card.
ask_income: Got it. Now send your Income Certificate.
ask_land: Now send your 7/12 land record extract.
blurry_retry: That image was too blurry to read. Please resend it in better light.
extract_failed: I could not read that document. Please send a clearer photo.
name_mismatch: Problem found: the name on your identity card ({a}) does not match the owner name on the land record ({b}). Please check the spelling before submitting.
income_name_mismatch: Problem found: the name on your identity card ({a}) does not match the name on the Income Certificate ({b}).
income_stale: Problem found: your Income Certificate is dated {d}, which is older than 12 months. Please provide a recent one.
land_stale: Problem found: your 7/12 extract was printed on {d}, which is older than 6 months. Please get a fresh extract.
land_too_large: Problem found: the 7/12 extract shows {n} hectares of land. EWS requires less than 5 acres (2.02 hectares).
land_area_unreadable: I could not read the land area on the 7/12 extract. Please resend it.
land_date_unreadable: I could not read the date on the 7/12 extract. Please resend it.
pin_invalid: Problem found: the PIN code on the Aadhaar card reads {p}, which is not 6 digits. Please check it against the card.
survey_missing: I could not read the survey number on the 7/12 extract. Please resend it.
land_operator_entry: Type the survey number, area and date from the paper 7/12 — the AI does not read these numbers reliably. Area must be under 2.02 hectares and the extract under 6 months old.
panel_operator_field: Type this from the paper document.
name_unreadable: I could not read the name on this document. Please use a clearer photo.
upload_ok: {f}: no problems found — this document should not be rejected.
upload_unknown_doc: I could not tell which document this is. Expected an Aadhaar card, income certificate or 7/12 extract.
upload_format_bad: {f} is a {t} file, but this upload slot accepts {a}.
pop_summary: {n} filled · {o} for you to type · {c} to check
pop_no_option: No matching option in this list.
panel_verify_field: Check this spelling against the document — it may not be printed in this script.
pop_not_curated: This form is not set up in the assistant yet, so nothing was filled automatically. Fill it by voice or typing: click a field and press Alt+Shift+V.
pop_not_a_name: Didn't catch a name — say it again, or type it.
panel_fill_nothing: Nothing filled — this client's documents have not been read yet, or this page has no matching fields.
income_too_high: Problem found: the certified income of Rs {n} is above the EWS limit of Rs 8,00,000.
income_unreadable: I could not read the income amount on the certificate. Please resend it.
income_date_unreadable: I could not read the issue date on the Income Certificate. Please resend it.
ask_purpose: Last question: what is the purpose of this application?
all_clear: All three documents checked and consistent.
voice_failed: I could not process that voice note. Please try again or type your reply.
voice_empty: I could not hear anything in that recording. Please try again.
review_header: Please check every detail against your documents before I generate the form:
review_hint: Reply OK to confirm, or send the number and the correct value to fix one. Example: 1 Ramesh Shankar Patil
review_unparsed: I did not understand that. Reply OK to confirm, or send a number and the correct value, like: 1 Ramesh Shankar Patil
form_ready: Your EWS application form is ready. Please review it before submission.
restart: Starting again. Send 'hi' when you are ready.
